candidate.problem: writeExportFile swallows every mkdir/writeFile failure (it only logs, and only when KERYX_VERBOSE is set) and returns normally. Its only caller, runHistoryExport (line 122), then proceeds to print "exported N run(s) to <file>" at line 131 and leaves exitCode 0. This violates error-handling.mdc Rule 3 / Iron Law 1 (a catch that hides a failure from a caller who then proceeds). The class has one site: the only other catch in the file (line 127) is a display-only fallback with a stated reason.
candidate.impact: A user or script exporting to an unwritable path (read-only dir, permission denied, path is a directory) is told the export succeeded with exit 0 and gets no file. Scripts attaching the export to a review or flow journal silently attach nothing. Fix: let the error propagate, or rethrow with context and cause (`throw new Error(`wiki history: cannot write export to ${file}`, { cause: error })`).
